Name: Realistic Looms Redux
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I found this old mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5222]Realistic Looms[/url] while looking for a loom retexture and I really liked the idea of it. Permissions were open, so I've updated, revived, and renewed the mod.

This mod changes the appearance of the loom and makes it so you can produce cloth using yarn with it. How do you get yarn? You put wool, fiber or any other cloth-making materials through the new Spinning Wheel machine, ﻿which is crafted using 50 wood and 5 wool. This is known by default with no unlock requirements.
